# Document

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Document`](gmeow-Document.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Document>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/documents`](../../slices/documents.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An abstract intellectual work of bounded textual or digital content — the conceptual document, independent of any particular file, record, or report. A specialization of [`gmeow:Work`](gmeow-Work.md).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Work`](gmeow-Work.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Document`](gmeow-Document.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Work`](gmeow-Work.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the abstract conceptual document — a report, spec, memo — at the [`gmeow:Work`](gmeow-Work.md) tier, independent of any file or rendering that carries it.

### Avoid when

- Avoid it for a concrete file, edition, or web rendering of the document (that is a [`gmeow:Manifestation`](gmeow-Manifestation.md) such as [`gmeow:WebPage`](gmeow-WebPage.md) or a media file), and avoid it for a published article (use [`gmeow:Article`](gmeow-Article.md)).

### How to use

- Type the conceptual work [`gmeow:Document`](gmeow-Document.md), give it [`gmeow:hasTitle`](../properties/gmeow-hasTitle.md) / [`gmeow:identifier`](../properties/gmeow-identifier.md) and the bibliographic dates; link each concrete carrier as a separate [`gmeow:Manifestation`](gmeow-Manifestation.md) rather than overloading the [`Work`](gmeow-Work.md) with file-level metadata.

### Examples

- ex:spec a [`gmeow:Document`](gmeow-Document.md); [`gmeow:hasTitle`](../properties/gmeow-hasTitle.md) ex:specTitle; [`gmeow:abstract`](../properties/gmeow-abstract.md) "A technical specification.".
